name: Braffet Berry Farm and Orchard
description: Braffet Berry Farm and Orchard is an agritourism farm in 9010 E 2250 North Rd, IL, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
